probe.text_sample: AI mobile app testing on real devices | Semaloop Event Human in the loop Human in the loop: where meaningful work lives. Sign up → Product Resources Pricing Careers Book a demo Log in Catch mobile bugs before your users do. Book a demo 00 Problem Mobile teams either skip end-to-end testing or waste time maintaining tests that break as their app changes. Either way, they lack confidence in every release. 01 Solution Agents that test apps like real users, across every flow that matters. Describe what matters . Explain the flow, behaviour, or outcome you care about, without writing code. Run it across real devices . Your app is tested the way a user would interact with it, across the devices that matter. Understand every failure . See what went wrong, why it failed, and all the context behind it. Fix it instantly . Go from failure to fix quickly, with a PR ready to merge. Confidence in every release .
